name: Luyuan Group Holding (Cayman) Limited
summary: Luyuan Group Holding (Cayman) Limited, through its subsidiaries, design, research, development, manufacture, and sale of electric vehicles and related accessories in Mainland China and Germany. The company offers electric motorcycles, electric bicycles, electric-assist e-bikes, leisure tricycles, scooters, commercial products, and related accessories under the Luyuan brand. Luyuan Group Holding (Cayman) Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Jinhua, China.
